[Source: Krauses_Food_and_the_Nutrition_Care_Process.pdf | Section: 16 Nutrition in infancy | Pages 322-335]

 Microwave heating is not recommended because of the 
risk of burns from formula that is too hot or unevenly heated. 
Any formula offered and not consumed at that feeding should 
be discarded and not reused later, because of bacterial con-
tamination from the infant’s mouth.
From Food and Drug Administration: Nutrient requirements for infant formulas, Final 
Rule (21 CFR 107), Fed Reg 50:45106, 1985.
